title: RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation
summary: A unified diffusion-based framework by Samsung that generates physically consistent camera raw images from text or sRGB inputs. It enables high-fidelity editing and device-specific synthesis for arbitrary camera sensors.
research_notes: Utilizes FLUX as a backbone model; supports real-time ISP operations like white balance and exposure on the linear raw output.

evolution.summary: Officially released in early 2026 as a first-of-its-kind unified raw generation framework. It is currently being integrated into Samsung's neural ISP and AI Experience (AX) roadmaps for future mobile photography.
